In Fairfax County Public Schools, technology strengthens the connection between home, school, and community. This video highlights how the FCPS Department of Information Technology supports students, educators, and families through reliable systems, responsive support, and accessible digital tools—from on-site technology specialists to the FCPS mobile app, online registration, and multilingual family resources. Much of this work happens behind the scenes, but its impact is felt every day in classrooms and homes across the division. Connecting School and Home: How FCPS Technology Supports Families and Learning "No matter your ability, your race, your gender... you can succeed and thrive if given the opportunity." In this episode of "In the Spotlight," Dominic Williams shares his incredible full-circle journey within Fairfax County Public Schools. Once a student who struggled with reading, Dominic was transformed by a teacher who made him feel seen and supported. Today, as an Assistant Principal, he is paying that favor forward. From working in the SACC program to becoming a Special Education teacher and administrator, Dominic’s story is a testament to the power of mentorship and the FCPS advantage of growing careers within the school division. From Struggling Reader to Assistant Principal: Dominic Williams' FCPS Journey Learn all about the "Back to Fairfax" initiative, FCPS's powerful "Grow Your Own" program that provides students with real-world work-based learning experiences. Back to Fairfax is key to building a future talent pipeline and addressing critical shortages in essential teaching and operational roles. FCPS is equipping students with practical skills, offering professional exposure, and encouraging students to return to FCPS after graduation. See how we’re growing our own!
